points.heading: Using their voices
points.summary: Use their voices expressively and creatively by singing songs and speaking chants and rhymes.

points.heading: Playing instruments
points.summary: Play tuned and untuned instruments musically.

points.summary: Listen with concentration and understanding to a range of high-quality live and recorded music.
